image.alt: Inside Goin’ Postal Aiken: the service counter with shipping supplies on display

body: Goin’ Postal Aiken is owned and run by Paul Ambroselli. The core of the business is “Pack, Ship and Mail”: a ship center for UPS, FedEx, USPS and DHL, and a commercial mail receiving agency for the USPS.

The Ambroselli family has lived and worked in Aiken County since 2019, and the store was the first business to open in the Ellenton Place II shopping center. Like every Goin’ Postal, it is independently owned and operated.
list: The only authorized DHL location in Aiken County
Cash, debit and all major cards

items.q: Which carriers can I ship with?
items.a: UPS, FedEx, USPS and DHL, including international shipping. We’re the only authorized DHL shipping location in Aiken County.

items.q: Can you pack it for me?
items.a: Yes. We pack items for shipping, make custom boxes, and sell packaging supplies.
Yes, notary service is available during business hours.

items.q: Can I drop off a prepaid package?

items.a: Cash, debit, Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover.

before: The store has no website of its own: its only page is a listing inside the franchise’s site, with “Franchise Info” and “E2 Visas” in the menu
The About text runs together with no line breaks, and has typos: “FeDex” for FedEx, and “seperated”
On a phone, the first screen shows no phone number or call button
after: A site of its own, with every service on one page
Hours with an “Open now” sign, and one tap to call
Directions that mention the landmarks: across from Sam’s Club
Package tracking for all four carriers, from one box
